description: This file defines several Odoo models and database views related to reporting tasks, user pipelines, closed tasks, and timesheet data within an Odoo module named 'report_task'. It includes class definitions, database view initialization methods, and external library imports.

classes.name: report_task_user_pipeline_open
classes.description: Model representing tasks by user and project, with a view created in init.

classes.name: report_closed_task
classes.description: Model for reporting closed tasks, with a view created in init.

classes.name: report_timesheet_task_user
classes.description: Model aggregating timesheet and task hours per user and month, with a view created in init.

methods.name: init
methods.description: Initializes database views for each report model by executing raw SQL commands.

methods.name: _get_task_hours
methods.description: Calculates total task hours for a user within a month.

methods.name: get_hrs_timesheet
methods.description: Calculates total timesheet hours for a user within a month.
